notes: *hath* is placed on the possessive לְ under rule 43, the clause being verbless and no הָיָה standing in it; אָדָם keeps its own *man*.
The bare relative שֶׁ takes *wherein*; rule 22's three-morpheme fusion is unavailable because no resumptive suffix is written in the clause.
The assimilated article of לָאָדָם is unrepresented, the ASV writing *man* with no *the* (rules 12, 29).
